gaps.title: Lake level state and trend are validated only against operator records and a prospective ledger
gaps.whyItMatters: The level state (in zone, rising, falling) and trend are rules over operator elevations; no prospective scoring exists yet, so the score is capped while NOT_VALIDATED.
gaps.bowfisherDecision: Whether a bowfisher can rely on a 'rising' or 'in zone' reading when choosing flooded margins or launch access.
gaps.stopCondition: Stop when the prospective ledger has scored enough predictions at the preregistered milestones, or when an operator threshold is needed.
gaps.expectedOutput: A scored level-prediction evaluation per lake class.

humanOrFieldValidationRequired.what: OPTIONAL: any existing or owner-supplied observations may be added as evidence; they are never required.

gaps.title: Most fleet lakes have no independent fresh level source
gaps.whyItMatters: A lake that depends on one feed goes stale or abstains when it fails; only a minority of fleet lakes have an independent daily level series.
gaps.bowfisherDecision: Whether the app can show a current level for the lake at all.
gaps.stopCondition: Stop when each fleet lake has a verified independent fresh source or a recorded owner action naming the operator.
gaps.expectedOutput: A per-lake source map with verified identities (measured pool elevation only, never regulation-schedule lines).

humanOrFieldValidationRequired.what: Operator level feeds for lakes with no public independent series.

gaps.title: Profiled share of the fleet is small, which caps the score
gaps.whyItMatters: The score is capped while only a few percent of the registry lakes are profiled.
gaps.bowfisherDecision: Which lakes the app can answer for.
gaps.stopCondition: Stop when the profiled share is decided by the owner or the cap is revisited.
gaps.expectedOutput: A decision on caps and a wider profiled set.

humanOrFieldValidationRequired.what: Owner decision on the scoring caps (audit R10).
